title: Clinic late cancellation
naturalLanguageRequirements: A patient may cancel an outpatient visit. The source text does not say whether a cancellation inside 24 hours charges a fee.
informalMarkdown:
# Functions

## Cancel a visit

A patient cancels an upcoming outpatient visit. Whether a cancellation inside 24 hours charges money is not stated.

# Data Resources

## Visit

The visit records the patient, the clinician, and the appointment time.

# Constraints

## Recorded cancellation

A cancelled visit stays on the schedule with a cancelled status.
